# `aitbc zk verify`

Verify a zero-knowledge proof against a circuit and public signals.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc zk verify [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--job-id` | text | — | no | Job ID whose receipt proof should be re-verified |
| `--proof` | text | — | no | Proof JSON, @file, or base64 string |
| `--public-signals` | text | — | no | Public signals JSON, @file, or base64 string |
| `--circuit` | text | `receipt_public` | no | Circuit name to verify against |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc zk verify
```
